rule: A source is imported only when usable is true: an official page states an open licence covering re-use of the vector records served. View-only services, priced products and data without a stated open licence are recorded and not imported. A publicly accessible file is not automatically open-licensed.

sources.title: BGS Geology 625k (DiGMapGB-625) bedrock
sources.attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026
sources.service_crs: OGC CRS84 (EPSG:27700 bbox-crs refused by server 2026-09-26)
sources.limitations: National-scale generalised interpretation. Unit boundaries can be hundreds of metres from their ground position. Not a site investigation.

sources.title: BGS Geology 625k (DiGMapGB-625) superficial deposits
sources.attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026
sources.limitations: Only large superficial bodies are shown at this scale. An empty result means none mapped at 1:625k, not that no superficial deposits exist.

sources.title: BGS Geology 50k (DiGMapGB-50) bedrock, superficial, artificial, mass movement
sources.licence: Vector data: BGS licence, £0.23 per km2 for commercial use. WMS view service: OGL-UK-3.0 with attribution.
sources.attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026 (WMS view only)
sources.finding: Not open as vector data on 2026-09-26. The dataset page prices it; the OpenGeoscience download list names 625k, not 50k; data.gov.uk v8 metadata says licence 'Not set' with 'No part of this work may be reproduced ... without the prior permission of the copyright holder'. Only the WMS is OGL for viewing. Polygons are not reconstructed from the WMS.

sources.title: BGS Single Onshore Borehole Index (SOBI)
sources.attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026
sources.service_crs: OGC CRS84 geometry; source easting/northing fields in EPSG:27700 are used as recorded

scans.finding: Scans are free to view, print or download from BGS under OGL; copyright of donated records is jointly vested in BGS and the donor, and confidential records are withheld. Linked only (scan_url as recorded); scans are not downloaded or redistributed.

sources.limitations: An index entry is not a log. Length codes below zero mean unknown or confidential and are left missing. Location precision is recorded per borehole.

sources.title: Development High Risk Area (coal)
sources.publisher: Mining Remediation Authority (formerly The Coal Authority)
sources.attribution: © Crown copyright; Mining Remediation Authority (formerly The Coal Authority) data, Open Government Licence v3.0
sources.service_crs: Stored EPSG:3857; requested as EPSG:4326 and projected to EPSG:27700 with OSTN15
sources.limitations: Screening area for planning, derived by the authority from recorded features. Absence is not proof of no mining.

sources.title: Coal Mining Reporting Area
sources.publisher: Mining Remediation Authority (formerly The Coal Authority)
sources.finding: Only a tile service is public (capabilities Map,TilesOnly on 2026-09-26; the listed map.bgs.ac.uk WMS returned an empty response). No open vector endpoint found. Not imported.

sources.title: Coal mine entries
sources.publisher: Mining Remediation Authority (formerly The Coal Authority)
sources.licence: WMTS view: OGL-UK-3.0. Vector data: licensed, from £4.09 per km2 (business internal use) per the price list dated 1 April 2026.
sources.finding: Public service is tiles only; point records are a priced licensed product. Not imported. Entries before 1872 may be unrecorded in any case.

sources.title: Aquifer Designation (bedrock and superficial), England
sources.publisher: Environment Agency and British Geological Survey
sources.licence: Not OGL for download: £0.35 per km2 for commercial download use; free to view on MAGIC; non-commercial users apply to the Environment Agency. data.gov.uk: 'No Licence Provided'.
sources.finding: Not usable as open vector data. Not imported; the aquifers field is left missing (null), not empty.

sources.title: Source Protection Zones [Merged]
sources.attribution: © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2016. All rights reserved.
sources.limitations: Zones are modelled from groundwater travel time around public abstractions; merged outlines drop per-source detail.

sources.title: BGS GeoSure
sources.licence: Full 1:50k GeoSure: licensed, £0.06 to £0.91 per km2. GeoSure 5 km hex grid: OGL-UK-3.0.
sources.finding: Site-scale GeoSure is licensed and not usable. The open 5 km hex grid is too coarse for a 3 km box and has no bounded service; not imported.

sources.title: Radon potential (BGS/UKHSA)
sources.publisher: British Geological Survey and UK Health Security Agency
sources.licence: Radon Potential dataset: licensed, £0.35 per km2. Indicative Atlas (1 km grid, highest class per square): OGL-UK-3.0, acknowledgement 'Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI [year]. Radon Potential classification UK Health Security Agency © Crown copyright [year]'.
sources.finding: The definitive dataset is licensed and not usable. The open Indicative Atlas is a national download behind an HTML download page with no bounded service; not imported here.

sources.title: Soilscapes (England and Wales)
sources.licence: LandIS copyright; use subject to a specific licensing agreement with Cranfield University (data.gov.uk isopen false). Viewer states it should not be used to support commercial activities; dataset leased separately.
